mechanism: five-separated storage (events/facts/tentatives/goals/notes with provenance) + budgeted projection (current>events 1400CU>facts 500CU relevant>tentatives 300CU>goal 600CU); relevance = char-bigram overlap with (current messages + goal), zero domain words, floor 0.12, recency fallback when no signal; closed goals never delete confirmed facts
extraction: model reports per-turn analysis facts/tentatives with src_ids; mechanism validates src in current window + hash-dedup; initial_kb.ongoing_plan seeds facts
honest_limits: V1 has no automatic correction/status-flip of old facts (deferred until long-story tests expose need)
never wins by deleting all content
